answer: Time-locked stake bonding deters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to deposit escrow capital before issuing commands. Storing valid bonds within a Merkle grove creates an oasis of verified peers, forcing an adversary to incur the verifiable opportunity cost of locked liquidity per identity. When a lease expires, the old credential becomes an inert relic barred from consensus. However, high capital barriers disproportionately exclude low-budget autonomous agents.
